title: Malicious code in @beloved-lenora/opencode-shared-rpc (npm)
description: The npm package @beloved-lenora/opencode-shared-rpc contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but full remediation requires rotating all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised machine due to potential persistent control by an attacker.
aiSummary: The npm package @beloved-lenora/opencode-shared-rpc has been identified as containing malicious code. Installation or execution of this package results in full compromise of the host system, potentially allowing attackers to gain control and access sensitive information such as secrets and keys. Because the attacker may maintain persistent access beyond the presence of the package itself, simply removing the package does not guarantee complete remediation.
aiImpact: Any system with this package installed or running should be considered fully compromised. Attackers may have gained full control over the system, including access to stored secrets and keys. This poses a severe risk of data breach, unauthorized access, and further malicious activity. Secrets and keys must be rotated immediately from a secure, unaffected environment to prevent misuse.
